name: Good things jar
summary: A jar between two friends through a rough week: each day each drops in one marble with a few words, the marbles stack up in day bands in their two colors, tapping any marble reads it, and on the last day the jar tips over and pours the week out as a list.
useWhen: exam week is killing me, need something good
lets each say one good thing a day till friday
gratitude thing but not cringe, just us two
rough week, cheer me up daily
dontUseWhen: a whole group cheering one person's win (use win-jar)
a habit streak to keep (use gym)
venting or emotional support as content

people.description: The two friends (names in the chat), left marble first

quote.description: What started it, in their words

marbles.description: Marbles already in, in day order; a day fills only after both have one in the day before

text.description: The good thing, a few words, in their voice
